primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: ORR was defined as the percentage of participants who had complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) per RECIST v1.1 by investigator determination.

groups.description: Pembrolizumab 200 mg administered intravenously every 3 weeks. Epacadostat 100 mg administered orally twice daily.
groups.title: Pembrolizumab + Epacadostat

groups.description: Standard of care (SoC) (sunitinib or pazopanib monotherapy). Sunitinib 50 mg administered orally once daily;4 weeks on, 2 weeks off for 6-wk cycle. Pazopanib 800 mg administered orally once daily.
groups.title: SoC (Sunitinib or Pazopanib)

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The Intention-to-Treat (ITT) population consisted of all randomized participants
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) of Pembrolizumab + Epacadostat Versus Standard of Care (SOC)
